title: SimBench-BW nvbit_slowdown_budget_exceeded sidecar
description: Sidecar emitted when an NVBit-traced kernel launch's wall-clock time exceeds the declared slowdown budget relative to a baseline non-traced reference run for the same row. Format mirrors the trace-budget family pattern at workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/trace_volume_exceeded.schema.json. Member of the trace-budget typed-reason family declared in tools/cloud/trace_budgets.py NVBIT_SLOWDOWN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED_SIDECAR; pinned in the original-plan exclusion-taxonomy list. The slowdown is computed as actual_wall_time_s / baseline_wall_time_s; the sidecar records both numerator and denominator so a downstream consumer can re-derive the ratio without re-walking the run summary.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema major version. Pinned to 1; a deliberate schema bump must update both this constant and consumers in lockstep.

slug.description: Row identifier from workloads/simbench_bw/roster.toml. Matches the row whose budget was exceeded.

shape_point.description: Trace shape point name (from shapes/<slug>.toml trace_shapes[].name) whose launch crossed the slowdown budget.

max_slowdown_ratio.description: Declared maximum slowdown ratio (actual / baseline). A row's value of 4.0 means the NVBit-traced run is allowed to take up to 4x the baseline wall time. Strictly greater than 1.0 because no slowdown is the baseline.

actual_slowdown_ratio.description: Observed slowdown ratio (actual_wall_time_s / baseline_wall_time_s) for the run that produced this sidecar. Strictly greater than 1.0; a value at or below 1.0 means the run was at or faster than baseline and no sidecar should have been emitted.

baseline_wall_time_s.description: Wall-clock seconds for the non-traced reference run used as the slowdown denominator.

actual_wall_time_s.description: Wall-clock seconds for the NVBit-traced run.

trace_budgets_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical trace_budgets.toml at the time the run was admitted. Downstream consumers compare this to the current canonical hash to refuse stale evidence.

allOf.description: actual_slowdown_ratio must exceed max_slowdown_ratio (otherwise the sidecar is BudgetViolationUntracked-equivalent noise). This invariant is enforced producer-side in workloads/simbench_bw/run_suite.py before sidecar emission; JSON Schema 2020-12 has no native cross-property comparison, so this allOf block documents the invariant for downstream consumers but does NOT structurally validate it. Compare workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/trace_volume_exceeded.schema.json which uses anyOf over const-pinned boolean flags to express its analogous invariant structurally.
